{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values in key columns
missing_values = data[['severity', 'biomarker_baseline']].isnull().sum()
print("Missing values in severity and biomarker_baseline:", missing_values)

# Check unique values in severity column
severity_unique = data['severity'].unique()
print("Unique values in severity column:", severity_unique)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_values = data['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0, -999, -999.00, -999.000])
if sentinel_values.any():
    print("Sentinel value -999.0 found in biomarker_baseline.")
else:
    print("No sentinel values found in biomarker_baseline.")"}
